fields.Participants: Cooperative Member, Co-op Verification Hotline Agent
fields.Trigger: Cooperative member wishes to purchase goods using co-op credit line

workflows.name: Cooperative Member Digital POS Account Association & Verification

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time API query to cooperative member databases returning member photo.
Controls: - CTL-20: Ensure POS cash/credit accountability; Cashier ID matching protocols.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Identity theft purchase risk**: Non-members use cooperative credentials to make purchases, causing chargeback disputes; mitigated by requiring dual identification checks matching ID photo.
System Touchpoints: - POS Checkout terminal (VS-08), B2B CRM module.

steps.activity: Present member credentials at checkout counter.
Scan member digital barcode on POS terminal.
Query central co-op registry database to verify member eligibility.
If digital lookup fails, check membership status manually.

fields.Trigger: Validated member request for high-value materials (> PHP 50,000) using co-op line

workflows.name: Cooperative Member Authorization and Purchase Order Match

Automation Opportunity: - OCR scanner parsing PO details and matching against basket contents.
Controls: - CTL-786: ensure controlled execution — Member Transaction Routing & Verification (PA-185.2). — legal authorization controls; Customer Service Lead PO validation.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope deviation risk**: Members purchase unauthorized retail items (appliances, consumer goods) on corporate construction POs; mitigated by blocking POS items not matching PO product classes.

steps.activity: Collect cooperative-issued Purchase Order (PO) or Authorization Letter from member.
Match PO specifications (material list, budget limit, jobsite address) with POS basket items.
Check PO authorization codes and signatories against co-op profile on system.
Scan and attach the PO document to the POS invoice transaction in ERP.

fields.Trigger: POS cashier initiates credit payment method on co-op account (W5305)

workflows.name: Real-time Credit Line Availability Check at Checkout

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time credit inquiry interface integrated within cash register UI.
Controls: - CTL-786 (ensure controlled execution — Member Transaction Routing & Verification (PA-185.2).)
- operational: finance risk controls; Credit limits enforced at system database levels.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-limit credit risk**: POS terminal completes transactions while co-op account is in credit block status due to network delays; mitigated by offline POS credit blocking policies.
System Touchpoints: - POS Checkout terminal (VS-08), ERP Credit module (VS-68).

steps.activity: POS system calculates basket total (net of co-op B2B discounts and VAT exemptions).
System queries parent co-op credit ledger balance in central ERP database.
If requested transaction exceeds remaining available credit, block checkout and issue credit limit alert.
If limit is sufficient, hold transaction amount and proceed to invoice lock.

fields.Trigger: Group order placement from multiple co-op members at B2B desk

Automation Opportunity: - ERP bulk split-billing tool automatically generating multiple credit invoices.
Controls: - CTL-20: POS cash/credit accountability; pricing matrix updates verified by Category Managers.
Cross-references: - links to VS-118 (pricing integrity), VS-11 (trade sales)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Discount calculation error risk**: Applying incorrect B2B price tiers to retail member accounts; mitigated by locking bulk discount authorizations to Store Manager approval.

steps.activity: Receive bulk material order sheets from group of co-op members.
Route order through bulk wholesale pricing calculator in ERP.
Split billing proportions to individual member profiles if requested.
Send quote to co-op office for central billing approval.

workflows.name: Credit Billing to Central Cooperative Account and Invoice Dispatch

Automation Opportunity: - Automated daily invoice compilation and EDI dispatch.
Controls: - CTL-30: Month-end control standards; Accounts Receivable reconciliations verified by Chief Accountant.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Billing invoice delivery risk**: Invoices not received by co-ops due to incorrect email records, delaying payments; mitigated by tracking email delivery status and verifying receipt via EDI.
System Touchpoints: - Accounts Receivable module (VS-16), BIR CAS portal (VS-79).

steps.activity: Compile daily POS transactions billed to cooperative central account.
Format electronic invoice document containing item details, member IDs, PO attachments, and billing totals.
Transmit consolidated credit invoices to cooperative accounts payable office via email and EDI.
Post transactions to Accounts Receivable sub-ledger in central ERP.

fields.Participants: Accounts Receivable Supervisor, Cooperative Finance Officer
fields.Trigger: Payment received from cooperative (bank transfer or check deposit)

workflows.name: Cooperative Account Payment Posting and Cash Application

Automation Opportunity: - Bank statement auto-matching algorithms parsing co-op deposit reference numbers.
Controls: - CTL-30: Month-end control standards; CFO cash ledger audits.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Payment misapplication risk**: Cash receipts applied to wrong cooperative accounts or wrong invoices, distorting customer statements; mitigated by requiring daily reconciliation of receipts to bank statements.

steps.activity: Match bank transfer references or check deposit details with open invoices in cooperative sub-ledger.
Input payment details in cash journal; apply receipts to specific invoices.
Investigate any payment variances with cooperative finance officer.
Clear invoices in sub-ledger; update co-op available credit limits.

fields.Trigger: Cooperative account balance exceeds credit limit (W5307) or payment is overdue (> 45 days)

workflows.name: Cooperative Credit Hold Flagging and Delinquency Lockout

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-lockout systems triggered when invoices pass overdue threshold dates.
Controls: - CTL-786 (ensure controlled execution — Member Transaction Routing & Verification (PA-185.2).)
- operational: finance risk controls; B2B Credit Director hold release approval.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit loss risk**: Delinquent accounts allowed to continue purchasing due to delayed system lockout; mitigated by automated database-level POS lockout triggers.
System Touchpoints: - Credit Risk system (VS-68), POS checkout terminal (VS-08).

steps.activity: Identify delinquent or over-limit cooperative accounts in system reports.
Activate credit hold flag in parent ERP account profile.
Trigger automated system lockout of co-op codes across all store POS registers.
Send formal delinquency notice detailing unpaid balances to co-op directors.

fields.Participants: Cooperative Member, Accounts Receivable Clerk, Store Manager
fields.Trigger: Cooperative flags transaction as unauthorized or disputes billing

workflows.name: Dispute Resolution for Member Unauthorized Purchases

Automation Opportunity: - Online dispute registry for tracking audit trail and resolution history.
Controls: - CTL-20: POS cash/credit accountability; credit memo approval matrix.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bad-debt leakage risk**: Writing off disputed sales without proper verification of cashier compliance with ID check policies; mitigated by reviewing POS signature card matches.

steps.activity: Receive dispute details: invoice number, disputed items, transaction date, co-op member name.
Retrieve transaction records: POS video logs, signature cards, scanned government IDs, PO attachments.
Conduct review meeting with store manager and co-op officers to present evidence.
If unauthorized purchase is confirmed due to cashier error, issue credit memo and update internal controls.
